narrative:
Morrow County has 24,049 registered voters, with 15.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 42.2%, a modest Democratic lean of 3.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
